question: For the Hawaii ERS 2017 PE RFP notice and 2022 PE RFP, SBCERS 2020 PE RFP, TRS Illinois FY25 PE RFP, Baltimore BCERS alternatives RFP, and Missouri LAGERS private-markets RFP, what minimum experience is required of the primary/lead consultant or, for SBCERS, at least one key professional assigned to the account?
gold_answer: Hawaii ERS 2017 PE notice: at least seven years of domestic and international investment consulting/management experience with public pension plans. Hawaii ERS 2022 PE RFP: at least seven years providing domestic and international private equity/debt consulting to public pension plans. SBCERS 2020: at least one key assigned professional has ten years recommending institutional PE investment programs, including three years with the current firm; this is not expressly a lead-only rule. TRS Illinois FY25: the primary consultant has at least three years of PE consulting to public/private pension funds or other highly comparable relevant experience. Baltimore BCERS: primary consultant at least five years of DB public-pension consulting and three years with the firm. Missouri LAGERS: lead consultant at least five years in a lead role recommending private-market investments to US public pension funds.
acceptance: For the clarified six-source scope: Hawaii 2017 and 2022 seven years (with respective investment consulting/management and PE/debt specialties); TRS three years or highly comparable relevant experience; Baltimore five years plus three with firm; LAGERS five years in lead role; SBCERS a key professional ten years, three with firm. TRS's 20% time commitment and SBCERS's separate monitoring/legal-review qualifications are extra context, not mandatory for the experience comparison. Under current broad wording, answers that consistently include related FPIF/INPRS mandates should not be penalized merely for additional scope.
candidate_answer:
| RFP | Minimum experience for the assigned consultant |
|---|---|
| **Hawaii ERS, 2017 PE notice** | Primary consultant: **7 years** providing domestic and international investment consulting and management services to public pension plans. (Notice, p. 1) |
| **Hawaii ERS, 2022 PE RFP** | Primary consultant: **7 years** providing domestic and international *private equity/debt* consulting services to public pension plans. (RFP, p. 17) |
| **SBCERS, 2020 PE RFP** | At least one key professional assigned to the account must have **10 years** recommending private-equity investments for institutional clients, including **3 years with the current firm**. The RFP separately requires at least one assigned key professional with **5 years** analyzing and monitoring institutional private-equity partnerships, and at least one with **5 years** reviewing partnership agreements and related legal documents. It does not say these must all be the same person. (RFP, p. 8) |
| **TRS Illinois, FY25 PE RFP** | Primary consultant: **3 years** providing private-equity investment consulting to public or private pension funds, **or other highly comparable relevant experience**. (Appendix B, p. 15) |
| **Baltimore BCERS, alternatives RFP** | Primary consultant: **5 years** consulting for public defined-benefit pension plans, plus **3 years employed by the proposing firm**. (RFP, p. 7) |
| **Missouri LAGERS, private-markets RFP** | Lead consultant: **5 years in a lead role** recommending private-market investments across the investment verticals to U.S. public pension funds. (RFP, p. 7) |
